display.purpose: The hero headline only; four lines at desktop, balanced wrapping, capped at 11.5vw. Hyphens and overflow-wrap are last resorts on every heading h1–h4.

headline.purpose: Section headings; document white on navy.

title.purpose: Service names, step titles, contact-side headings, the success heading; FAQ questions, the mobile panel's links and the success card's navy phone link at the fixed 1.25rem end; the contact aside's phone link at min(1.5rem, 8vw).

promise.purpose: The one white sentence under the comparison sheet, capped at 26em, before two Navy Chalk paragraphs.

lead.purpose: Hero and section-head paragraphs in Ink Diluted; the about lead in ink.

body.purpose: Default text at 18px/1.55, capped at 62ch; paragraphs, list items, definitions, addresses, summaries, the consent text and the mail and contact links may break anywhere as a last resort.

label.purpose: Field labels and legends, policy names, fact values, nav links (500), chip text (500), the form's intro sentence (400, Ink Diluted), the steps' timing lines (400, Ink Faint).

button.purpose: All buttons at a 1.15 line-height so a wrapped label keeps its box; the compact nav button drops to 0.9375rem and every button to 1rem below 560px.

caption.purpose: Brand subline, masthead contact, table headers (600), sheet notes, the mobile sheet's in-cell labels (600), errors, the sample tags (500), footer. The smallest size on the page.

figure.purpose: Tabular lining numerals on every premium, difference, total, year, phone number and step counter.

fontLoading.purpose: No visible fallback flash (block period) and no layout shift (one metric-matched face per weight band, covering every weight the page uses: 400, 500, 600, 700) while the two inlined Schibsted Grotesk faces load.

shadows.name: shadow-sheet
shadows.purpose: Documents resting on navy: the comparison sheet, the contact form, the hero portrait.

shadows.name: shadow-nav
shadows.purpose: The sticky nav once it has left its resting position.

shadows.name: shadow-panel
shadows.purpose: The open mobile menu panel floating over the page.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing: colour, border, transform and shadow transitions at 200–300ms.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Button, link, chip and input state changes. Under reduced motion buttons keep colour transitions only; the press transform, the arrow link's slide and the FAQ mark's rotation transition are removed.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Comparison-sheet rows settling in from 8px below, staggered 110ms per row; triggered by an observer at threshold 0 with a -35% bottom root margin (the sheet reveals once its top edge enters the upper 65% of the viewport), with a 6-second fallback that reveals the sheet regardless.

motion.name: duration-count
motion.purpose: Recommended amounts counting from current to recommended premium with a cubic ease-out after a 200ms pause; every difference and the total are derived from the counted values on each frame; reduced motion shows the final state.

layout.navHeight: 60px minimum; the bar's measured height is written to --nav-measured by a ResizeObserver
layout.scrollbar: scrollbar-color only (Anodised Aluminium thumb on the plaster track); OS default width kept

focusRing.offsetOnSheetTableRegion: -3px (drawn inside, because the sheet clips its contents)
focusRing.halo: none, except the invalid consent checkbox while focused: box-shadow 0 0 0 5px {colors.sheet}, 0 0 0 7px {colors.error} outside the navy ring
focusRing.invalidTextInput: keeps the {colors.error} border under the navy ring

forcedColors.chipChecked: Highlight fill and border, HighlightText, 3px Highlight outline inset
forcedColors.navUnderline: hidden except on the current link
forcedColors.panelCurrent: 3px Highlight left border on the mobile panel's current link
forcedColors.order: the forced-colours block closes the stylesheet

mobileNavPanel.position: fixed from the bar's bottom (--panel-top, set by script on open and resize, one layout read per frame) to the viewport bottom
mobileNavPanel.pageLock: html.menu-open{overflow:hidden} under 860px while the panel is open
mobileNavPanel.closes: Escape, click outside the nav, click on any link in the bar or panel, Tab out

layout.navUnder480: the bar never wraps: flex-wrap nowrap, 8px gap; the toggle keeps its content width (flex none) and the compact button yields (flex 0 1 auto, min-width 0), wrapping its label at line-height 1.1 with 12px side padding and breaking a word if it must (overflow-wrap anywhere)

sampleTag.purpose: The one device that marks invented data, always worded "Vzorčni podatki": the sheet head badge, the first row of the about facts list, the contact aside's office heading.

layout.brandLink: content-width (flex 0 1 auto, margin-right auto) in masthead and footer, so the focus ring hugs the logo and name
layout.contactGrid: children min-width 0, so the form and the aside can shrink below their content; collapses at 960px
layout.sheetTable: table-layout fixed above 700px: policy column 44%, difference column 14%, so the count-up never resizes a column

narrative.overview:
The site is the advisor's office with the client's documents laid out on the desk. Every material on the page is one that is visible in the founder's portrait, taken literally: the plaster wall, lifted a few tones toward white, becomes the page ground, the navy wool of the suit becomes the two bands that hold the comparison sheet and the contact form, the anodised aluminium of the office furniture becomes every hairline rule, and the plant's green appears only where something is covered or better. Documents are drawn as documents: white sheets with 2px corners, 1px hairlines inside them, and one soft shadow that sets them on the desk.

Independence is demonstrated, not claimed. The central object is a real comparison sheet across insurers with tabular figures, and the rest of the page is arranged around it like paperwork: ruled definition rows for services, a numbered hairline column for the process, a grid of hairline cells for the thirteen partner logos, ruled rows for facts and questions. Density is calm and editorial: an 18px body at a 62ch measure, 96px between sections on desktop, headings that tighten as they grow. One typeface, Schibsted Grotesk, carries everything from the 68px headline to the 15px footer line.

The build refuses the category arrangement it replaces: no stock-family hero, no row of icon cards, no stat strip, no testimonial carousel, no gradients, no pills, no small uppercase labels above headings. The only icons are an authored 1.5px-stroke mark set (arrow, menu, close, plus, phone) used inside controls. The only shield on the page is the GJ logo itself. Wherever the page shows invented data (the sample sheet, the facts list, the office address) it says so with one filled sample tag, so the demonstration never passes for a record.
keyCharacteristics: Plaster-white ground lightened from the warm wall tone beside the founder; navy wool owns whole regions, never tints.
Documents as white sheets: 2px corners, 1px aluminium hairlines, one soft offset shadow.
Aluminium hairlines rule every list; the strong rule opens and closes, the soft rule separates; controls are outlined in the darker Control Grey.
Green appears only as the "covered / better" mark.
One typeface at four weights; tight-tracked bold headings, normal-tracked body, tabular lining figures everywhere a number appears.
5/7 and 7/5 split grids that collapse to one column at 860px.
Every control at least 44px tall; the 2px focus ring follows its surface (navy on plaster and white, white on navy).
One filled sample tag marks every piece of invented data: the sheet badge, the facts list, the office block.

rules.name: The Room Rule
rules.body: Every colour derives from a material visible in the founder's portrait: plaster (the wall tone, lightened), navy wool, aluminium, ink, plant. The one exception is Red Pen, and it appears only on an invalid field.

rules.name: The Whole-Region Rule
rules.body: Navy owns regions and controls: the desk band, the contact band, the primary button, the selected chip, the focus ring. It is never a tint, a wash, a card background or a hairline on the plaster ground.

rules.name: The Green Means Better Rule
rules.body: Plant Green marks the recommended, covered or confirmed state and nothing else. A screen with no recommendation has no green on it.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Schibsted Grotesk is the only typeface the reader sees. There is no second face for display, no monospace for figures and no system face in the design; the metric-matched Schibsted Fallback exists only to hold the lines while the grotesk loads. A number that must align uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums`.

rules.name: The Tightening Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens as size grows: -0.015em at title, -0.02em at headline, -0.03em at display. Body and labels stay at normal tracking, and nothing is set in letter-spaced uppercase.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Any number a reader might compare (premiums, differences, totals, years, phone numbers, step counters) is set in tabular lining figures, with a narrow no-break space as the thousands separator (`1 180 €`).

rules.name: The Paper-On-Desk Rule
rules.body: Only a document lying on navy casts a shadow. Containers on the plaster ground are flat and drawn with hairlines; the shadow is always soft, navy-tinted and negatively spread, never a hard offset.

rules.name: The Hairline Depth Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy on a flat plane is drawn with two hairlines: Anodised Aluminium opens and closes a list, Aluminium Soft separates its rows. A control's edge (input, chip, ghost button) is the darker Control Grey so it holds 3:1 on white. On navy, list hairlines are Navy Seam. The sample tag is the one label that is filled rather than outlined: Aluminium Soft on white and plaster, Navy Seam on navy, with no border on either.

rules.name: The Ring Follows the Surface Rule
rules.body: The focus ring is always a 2px outline with 2px corners, offset 3px on buttons, links, chips and summaries, 2px on text inputs, the textarea and the consent checkbox, and 3px inward on the sheet's table region, which clips; its colour is the ink of its surface: navy on plaster and on white sheets, white directly on navy, and navy again inside a white sheet that lies on navy. There is no halo, except the white-then-red double band that keeps an invalid consent checkbox's error visible while it is focused.

dos: Do set body text at 18px/1.55 in Near-Black Ink with a 62ch measure, and lead paragraphs at 20px/1.5 in Ink Diluted.

Do load Schibsted Grotesk with `font-display: block` over the three metric-matched Schibsted Fallback faces (400–500, 600, 700–900), so there is no fallback flash and no layout shift at any weight the page uses.
Do draw every list with hairlines: Anodised Aluminium opens and closes it, Aluminium Soft separates rows (Navy Seam on navy); outline controls in Control Grey.
Do draw documents as white sheets with 2px corners, 1px hairlines inside, and the sheet shadow only when they lie on navy.
Do give navy whole regions and controls: bands, primary buttons, selected chips, the focus ring.
Do set every comparable number in tabular lining figures with a narrow no-break space before the euro sign.
Do keep every control at least 44px tall: 52px primary buttons, 50px inputs, 44px chips, nav links and compact nav button, 44px minimum on links that act as controls.

Do draw focus as a 2px outline, offset 3px (2px on text inputs, the textarea and the consent checkbox; 3px inward on the sheet's clipped table region), navy on plaster and white, white on navy, navy again inside a white sheet on navy; keep an invalid field's red border under the ring.

Do honour forced colours: Highlight fill, border and a 3px Highlight outline on checked chips, a ButtonText border on buttons, the nav underline only on the current link, and a 3px Highlight left border on the panel's current link.
Do use the authored 1.5px-stroke mark set (arrow, menu, close, plus, phone) as inline SVG inside controls only, at 16px to 22px.

Do mark every piece of invented data with the one filled "Vzorčni podatki" tag (500, no border; Aluminium Soft fill with Ink Diluted text on white and plaster, Navy Seam fill with Navy Chalk text on navy); it is the only device and the only wording for it.
Do ship rasters as WebP, lossless for logos (lossy with a lossless alpha plane only where a gradient makes lossless heavy), and reuse an inlined source rather than embedding it twice.

Do collapse every 5/7 and 7/5 split to one column at 860px and honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by showing final states: no sheet reveal, smooth scroll, button press, arrow slide or FAQ-mark rotation transition; buttons keep colour transitions only.

Do give headings `hyphens: auto` and `overflow-wrap: anywhere`, and prose, list items, addresses, summaries, the consent text and the contact and mail links `overflow-wrap: anywhere`, as last resorts against a long Slovene word; soft-hyphenate a long proper name (`Zavaro­valnica`) where it must wrap in a narrow cell.
donts: Don't add a second typeface, a monospace face or a system face to the design; Schibsted Grotesk at 400–700 is the whole system, and Schibsted Fallback exists only to hold the lines while it loads.
Don't set small uppercase, letter-spaced labels above headings; section heads are a headline beside a lead paragraph.
Don't use pills, circles or any radius other than 2px; don't use gradients anywhere.
Don't use green for buttons, headings or decoration; it marks the recommended or covered state only.
Don't tint the plaster ground with navy or put a navy hairline on it; navy hairlines belong on navy.
Don't cast shadows from containers on the plaster ground, and don't use hard offset shadows; the only shadow is the soft sheet shadow on navy.

Don't add a halo to a focused text input; the ring is always the 2px outline. The one halo on the page is the invalid consent checkbox's white-then-red band, which exists only because a native checkbox has no border to turn red.
Don't thin or restyle the scrollbar's width; it keeps the OS default and is only coloured.
Don't lay out services, benefits or steps as rows of identical icon cards; use ruled rows or hairline-opened numbered columns.
Don't add shield or protection imagery; the GJ logo is the only shield on the page.
Don't set any text below 0.9375rem; the mobile sheet's in-cell labels and the footer are the floor.
Don't promise anything free or leave a fee unstated; the fee model is only ever "agreed in writing in advance", and the first step is "30 minut, brez obveznosti".
